entities.summary: Nate Washington is an American former professional football player who was a wide receiver in the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Tiffin Dragons and was signed by the Pittsburgh Steelers as an undrafted free agent in 2005. Washington played on two Super Bowl-winning teams during four seasons with the Steelers. He then played six seasons for the Tennessee Titans before playing his eleventh and final season for the Houston Texans.
